name: Frida Kahlo
hook: Mexico's most famous woman painter — self-portraits, Diego Rivera and the Blue House.

facts.label: Mexican artist
facts.statement: Frida Kahlo was a Mexican painter born in Coyoacán in Mexico City, where her Blue House, the Casa Azul, is now the Frida Kahlo Museum.

facts.label: Diego Rivera
facts.statement: She married muralist Diego Rivera in 1929 and remarried him in 1941 after a separation — a joke said he wed her twice.

facts.label: self-portraits
facts.statement: She is famous for her many self-portraits, including a 1937 one dedicated to Leon Trotsky, the Russian exile who stayed with her.

facts.label: "Diego and I"
facts.statement: "Diego and I" was the first painting by a Latin American artist to sell for more than $1 million.

facts.label: "Viva la Vida"
facts.statement: Her painting "Viva la Vida" inspired the title of Coldplay's 2008 No. 1 hit of the same name.

facts.label: Fulang-Chang
facts.statement: Her self-portrait "Fulang-Chang and I" shows her pet monkey Fulang-Chang wearing a ribbon.
